title: Dataset Public Benchmark Request
description: PUT /api/v1/datasets/{dataset_id}/public-benchmark request body: set or clear the dataset's public-benchmark opt-in (content identity ruling D3, docs/identity/content-identity-v1.md). While set, hosted version content-identity reads also carry each example's UNKEYED public_input_digest (exu1:) for cross-tenant contamination checks. Only a tenant owner/admin (or platform admin) may change it, and never through an API key; the generic dataset create/update bodies cannot set it.

public_benchmark.description: true opts the dataset in to unkeyed public digests; false opts it out (digests disappear from subsequent reads).
